create_hookmanager_instance: create a HookManager instance to manage named hook callbacks with a dictionary of callables
register_hook_callback: register a callable function to a named hook in the HookManager for later invocation
unregister_hook_callback: unregister a previously registered callable function from a named hook in the HookManager
call_hook_by_name: call all registered hooks by name and pass keyword arguments to each registered callback function
fork_hookmanager_subtree: fork a HookManager to create a subtree of hooks filtered by a name prefix pattern
